rv.q: Lovers of Fiddler on the Roof will surely enjoy this fresh take on the endearing classic.
If you see one musical in Melbourne this year, make it this one.
Director Jordan Fein and resident director Gary Abrahams orchestrate a magnificent, exultant, deeply affecting revitalisation of Fiddler on the Roof.
This new production of Fiddler on the Roof is stunning – visually, aurally and emotionally.
This production balances humour and a rich musical score with the tragedy of a community uprooted from everything it has known.
Fiddler on the Roof is a show with a lot of heart, wonderful music and some innovative touches that enhance the overall performance.
